title: Extuberance
summary: EXTU'BERANCE EXTU'BERANCY, noun [Latin extuberans, extubero; ev and tuber, a puff.] 1. In medicine, a swelling or rising of the flesh; a protuberant part. 2. A knob or swelling part of a body.
